title: Vietnamese-Style Meatball Buns
description: A fusion twist on traditional Chinese bao, featuring flavorful Vietnamese-style meatballs in a soft bun.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine minced meat, noodle paste, fish sauce, scallions, and garlic. Mix well.
Form meat mixture into small meatballs and place on a baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the buns by baking them in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Assemble the buns by placing a few meatballs in each bun, and serving immediately.
